lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: The pilgrimage is complete. You saw more than most travellers do, and still allowed the rite to finish.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: I am choosing to remember the part where you owe us fuel.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: A sensible memory. The Choir remembers restraint too. If there is more work, someone will find you.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: Until then, courier. Try not to listen too closely when the dark sings back.
